# `project` operations

10 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all areas](README.md).

### project.inspect

**Open project**

Detect frameworks and available platforms without executing project code. For a Gradle build, android lists each app module's application ID, namespace, min, target and compile SDK, build types, flavors and variants as read from the build files and versions catalog; values only Gradle can compute are listed under unresolved.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.inspect '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### project.configure

**Configure project**

Save the deployment application ID and explicit command-array tasks; update xtool's bundleID when applicable.

Annotations: **destructive**, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |

| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `application_id` | string |  | `""` |  |
| `tasks` | object |  |  | Task names mapped to argv arrays; replaces configured tasks |

```sh

```

### project.create

**Create project**

Create a native Android app, a Jetpack Compose app in Kotlin with one UI test (kind compose), an Android app with Swift core, SwiftUI iOS app (xtool), or Flutter app in a new directory. With build:true, an xtool project is also built in the same job; project.app then names the .app.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `kind` | string | yes |  | one of `swift-android`, `android`, `compose`, `xtool`, `flutter` |
| `name` | string |  | `"TomaccoApp"` |  |
| `organization` | string |  | `"com.example"` |  |
| `build` | boolean |  | `false` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.create '{"path":"<path>","kind":"swift-android"}'
```

### project.execute

**Start build / test**

Execute a build, tests, lint or named project task as a durable cancellable job. An identical active request reuses its job; different work for the occupied project returns workspace_busy with the active job. Use job.send for Flutter Hot Reload.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `platform` | string |  | `"android"` | one of `android`, `ios`, `web`, `linux` |
| `action` | string |  | `"build"` | one of `build`, `test`, `lint`, `instrumented-test`, `task` |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
| `format` | string |  | `"apk"` | one of `apk`, `aab`, `ipa` |
| `sign` | boolean |  | `false` |  |
| `task` | string |  | `""` | Name of an explicitly configured project task |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `1800` | 1 to 86400 |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.execute '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### project.run

**Build & run on device**

Build and deploy to a selected Android/iOS device. Flutter supports interactive hot reload via job.send. An identical active request reuses its job; different work for the occupied project returns workspace_busy with the active job. Use job.send for Flutter Hot Reload.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `platform` | string | yes |  | one of `android`, `ios` |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `bundle_id` | string |  | `""` | Android application ID for Gradle projects (default: the variant's ID read from the build files, or tomacco.json's applicationId), or exact installed iPhone bundle ID to resolve ambiguous xtool signing mappings. Omit for automatic iPhone detection. |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
| `variant` | string |  | `""` | Gradle build variant to install, such as freeDebug. Required when the app has product flavors; otherwise the configuration's build type. |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.run '{"path":"<path>","platform":"android","device":"<device>"}'
```

### project.watch

**Watch and rerun app**

Watch a project's source files and, whenever they change and have stayed unchanged for debounce_ms, build, install and launch the app again with project.run, as a durable job; it also runs the app once at the start. Build output, dependency and tool directories (build, .gradle, .dart_tool, node_modules, Pods, .git and others) are ignored. For a Flutter project it starts one Flutter session and sends it Hot Reload on each change, starting a new session when that one has ended. Each cycle writes one line to the job's log: the files that changed and how the run ended. Cancel the job to stop watching; runs it started are cancelled with it.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `platform` | string | yes |  | one of `android`, `ios` |
| `device` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Device serial / UDID from device.list |
| `bundle_id` | string |  | `""` | Android application ID for Gradle projects (default: the variant's ID read from the build files, or tomacco.json's applicationId), or exact installed iPhone bundle ID to resolve ambiguous xtool signing mappings. Omit for automatic iPhone detection. |
| `configuration` | string |  | `"debug"` | one of `debug`, `release` |
| `variant` | string |  | `""` | Gradle build variant to install, such as freeDebug. Required when the app has product flavors; otherwise the configuration's build type. |
| `debounce_ms` | integer |  | `800` | 100 to 10000; How long the files must stay unchanged before a cycle starts, in milliseconds |
| `ignore` | array of string |  |  | up to 50 items; More directory names to leave out, besides build, .gradle, .dart_tool, node_modules, Pods, .git and other build and tool directories |
| `timeout` | integer |  | `86400` | 60 to 86400; Seconds after which the watch ends |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.watch '{"path":"<path>","platform":"android","device":"<device>"}'
```

### project.dependency_updates

**Check dependency updates**

Compare the versions a Gradle build declares, in gradle/libs.versions.toml and its build files, with the newest versions in Maven metadata from Google Maven, Maven Central and the Gradle Plugin Portal. Read-only, as a job whose report.json lists each dependency and plugin with its source line, latest stable and latest version and a status. Answers offline at once when no repository host resolves.

Annotations: read-only, idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `repositories` | array of string |  |  | up to 10 items; Maven repository base URLs (https:// or file:///) to ask in order instead of the defaults |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.dependency_updates '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### project.import_xcode

**Import Xcode project**

Write an xtool adapter package for an .xcodeproj with the pinned omarchy-apple-dev xcodeproj2xtool.py, by default in omarchy-xtool beside the project. Returns what the generator could not map as warnings. Build the adapter with project.execute. Needs only ios.toolkit_install's checkout.

Annotations: writes, not idempotent, open world.

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `project` | string | yes |  | non-empty; Absolute local filesystem path |
| `target` | string |  | `""` | Application target, when the project has several |
| `out` | string |  | `""` | Absolute path of the adapter directory |
| `bundle_id` | string |  | `""` |  |

```sh
tomaccoctl call project.import_xcode '{"project":"<project>"}'
```
